sourceChecks.text: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the LORD’s word in your mouth is truth.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: After many days, the LORD’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired the LORD’s altar that had been thrown down.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the LORD’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: The LORD’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, the LORD’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He said to him, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen’s equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: The LORD’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。
